def answer_back_of_womans_head(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    head_patches = image_patch.find("head")
    if not head_patches:
        return "No head found in the image."
    
    back_of_head_patches = [patch for patch in head_patches if patch.verify_property("head", "back")]
    if not back_of_head_patches:
        return "No back of head found in the image."
    
    woman_patches = [patch for patch in back_of_head_patches if patch.verify_property("head", "woman")]
    if not woman_patches:
        return "No woman's back of head found in the image."
    
    woman_back_of_head_patch = woman_patches[0]
    description = woman_back_of_head_patch.simple_query("Describe the back of the woman's head.")
    location = woman_back_of_head_patch.llm_query("Where is the woman located?", long_answer=False)
    
    return f"The back of the woman's head is described as '{description}' and she is located in {location}."
